title: A number that rolls to its word, on the real thing it measures
goal:
A device for a number that is never static (_corpus/keyframes-full-visual.md 3.6), shown on or beside the real thing it measures. params: `image` (optional, the real object), `unit`, `denominator?`; the value comes from object.dataset with dataset.producerLabel shown legibly (CONTRACT rule 5).

Verbs: enter, roll (digits roll like an odometer from the previous value to the event's value, via countTo in kit/verbs.ts, landing on the event frame + 18), fill (a bar or ring on the object fills to the value as a share of denominator), exit. unit and denominator never change during the object's life.

## Tests
- the shown value equals the target from roll + 18 and never overshoots it
- producerLabel is drawn
- fill is 0 before its event and the share after
- tall and wide fixtures render
contract: Rules for every device (apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md): Device({object, events, box, tokens, aspect, frame}), a pure function of its props; state only from stateAt(events, object.obj, frame); animation only from progress() and drift() with MOTION timing, and the helpers in kit/verbs.ts once they exist; colours only from tokens (raw hex refused); type roles from HOUSE_FONTS; no Math.random, no f % N, no wall clock; author 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 slots separately. Register the device in devices/registry.ts (one line) and in config/ve/devices.json with exactly the verbs below, and update verbs.test.ts. Follow the builder method in _corpus/keyframes-full-visual.md section 8: the picture comes from object.params (an image path for the real thing, its labels), never a generic shape standing in for it. Verbs, exactly: enter, roll, fill, exit.
acceptance:
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/count_roll
npx vitest run apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/verbs.test.ts
python scripts/ve/check_route.py
